name: UNIPAK FOODS INC.
old_description: At UniPak Foods, we are your one-stop shop for all your sourcing, packaging, and blending needs.
about:
UniPak Foods operates from Union, New Jersey, offering blending, packaging, and ingredient sourcing services for food businesses. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides blending services for granular, powder, and grain products, paired with packaging in pillow pouches, stand-up pouches, sachets, glass and PET jars with shaker or grinder tops, and cartonized pouches. It also sources ingredients such as beans, rice, oats, specialty grains, seeds, spices, and seasonings. Facility size, headcount, and annual volumes are not published.

UniPak serves food manufacturers, spice blenders, and brands seeking co-packing or private-label solutions. Its product lineup includes beans, rice, flavored oats, corn, croutons, specialty grains, seeds, sazon, and confectionery items, indicating a focus on dry grocery and seasoning categories.

UniPak emphasizes superior quality, customer service, and quick turnaround times as its differentiators, positioning itself as a one-stop shop for sourcing, blending, and packaging.
